summary: Primary-source applicability research for the historical BoB/Vijaya/Dena 2019 case and an India-focused product. This is a dated research matrix, not a legal opinion or launch clearance. Current rules are separated from historical and future-effective rules; unresolved rights and exemption questions block automatic legal conclusions.

rows.rule: BoB/Vijaya/Dena is a statutory nationalised-bank amalgamation, not a private-bank section 44A merger.
rows.entities: Bank of Baroda; Vijaya Bank; Dena Bank
rows.provision: Banking Companies (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertakings) Acts 1970 and 1980, section 9; G.S.R. 2(E), Scheme clauses 1(2), 3–4
rows.effective_date: Notification 2019-01-02; scheme effective 2019-04-01
rows.required_action: Store the Gazette and effective date; retain original entity identities and scheme-specific transfers. Do not infer NCLT approval or acquisition accounting from the word merger.
rows.verification_status: Verified historical Gazette; false means no further research needed for this narrow classification, not legal clearance.

rows.rule: Banking-company voluntary amalgamation requires the applicable RBI route and approvals.
rows.entities: Banking companies within paragraph 3; special bank classes require their own directions
rows.provision: Banking Regulation Act 1949, section 44A; RBI Commercial Banks – Voluntary Amalgamation Directions 2025, paragraphs 3, 6–13
rows.effective_date: 2025-11-28 immediate commencement
rows.required_action: Record board approvals, shareholder resolution, swap valuation and RBI sanction separately. Classify PSBs separately. Check entity-specific directions before enabling an additional bank case.
rows.verification_status: Current RBI text verified; 2016 direction is historical, not the current default.

rows.rule: A bank/NBFC amalgamation also needs the tribunal route and RBI NOC before approaching it.
rows.entities: Banking company and NBFC
rows.provision: RBI Commercial Banks – Voluntary Amalgamation Directions 2025, paragraphs 6(3), 9 and 12; Companies Act 2013 sections 230–234
rows.effective_date: 2025-11-28 for RBI direction
rows.required_action: Capture RBI NOC, tribunal order, appointed/effective dates, conversion of accounting basis and any conditional relief. Keep an acquisition or loan-book transfer out of the merger pipeline.
rows.verification_status: RBI paragraph 12 verified; transaction-specific orders remain necessary.

rows.rule: Section 45 reconstruction/amalgamation is a special statutory process and must not be labelled an ordinary voluntary merger.
rows.entities: Banking institution subject to section 45 scheme
rows.provision: Banking Regulation Act 1949, section 45, particularly subsections (4) and (7)
rows.effective_date: Act as amended; effective date is the relevant government scheme date
rows.required_action: Require the actual RBI/government scheme and any moratorium terms; identify creditor, depositor and capital-treatment changes independently.
rows.verification_status: Statutory route verified; no resolution scheme is presumed applicable to BoB 2019.

rows.rule: NBFC amalgamations have NCLT and RBI requirements with distinct control thresholds.
rows.entities: NBFCs across layers; counterpart NBFC or non-NBFC
rows.provision: RBI NBFC – Voluntary Amalgamation Directions 2025, paragraphs 3, 6 and 7; Companies Act sections 230–234
rows.effective_date: 2025-11-28 immediate commencement
rows.required_action: Record both NBFC NOCs for NBFC/NBFC cases; track surrendered registration. Check control, 26% shareholding and more-than-30% director-change triggers and the registration status of a surviving non-NBFC.
rows.verification_status: Official paragraph 7 verified; applicable counterparty branch must be selected.

rows.rule: Acquisition of control is distinct from a merger; prior RBI permission can be required without changing management.
rows.entities: NBFC categories specified in paragraph 3; HFC/SPD exceptions differ
rows.transaction_type: Share acquisition or transfer of control
rows.provision: RBI NBFC – Acquisition of Shareholding or Control Directions 2025, paragraphs 3, 6–10
rows.required_action: Classify acquisition separately; test control/26% triggers and special-category conditions. Record RBI approval and applicable 30-day public notice before ownership/control transfer.
rows.verification_status: Official text verified; no generic threshold is applied to every NBFC subtype.

rows.rule: Companies Act schemes require stakeholder/regulator notices, tribunal sanction and accounting-standard support where applicable.
rows.entities: Companies including relevant NBFCs
rows.effective_date: Transaction-date consolidated law required; sections 230–232 operational framework from December 2016
rows.required_action: Collect the scheme, notices, auditor accounting certificate, NCLT order and Registrar filing. Distinguish appointed date from legal effective date and first combined reporting.
rows.verification_status: Official Act text retrieved; exact commencement notification and later rule amendments not exhaustively reconciled.

rows.rule: Listed transactions and results carry exchange/SEBI disclosure and, for applicable schemes, observation/no-objection requirements.
rows.entities: Listed banks/NBFCs; distinguish equity and debt listings
rows.provision: SEBI LODR Regulations 2015: regulations 11, 30 with Schedule III, 33, 37 and 94; 59A for applicable debt schemes; Scheme Master Circular 2023
rows.effective_date: LODR official index last amended 2026-07-14; scheme master circular 2023-06-20, subject to subsequent circulars
rows.required_action: Retain event/result filings, exchange observations and approvals. Do not impose regulation 37 identically on every statutory-bank case; check exemptions and transaction-date rules. Verify subsequent scheme circulars before live legal assertions.
rows.verification_status: Current consolidated LODR landing page verified; every operative amendment/exception and current exchange SOP not exhaustively checked.

rows.rule: The statutory nationalised-bank route had a specific ten-year combinations exemption covering the 2019 period.
rows.entities: Nationalised banks under the 1970/1980 Acts
rows.provision: Competition Act sections 5, 6 and 54; S.O. 2828(E) published 2017-08-30
rows.effective_date: Ten years from 2017-08-30
rows.required_action: Store this basis against BoB 2019; do not describe it as a CCI merger approval or extend it to all banks/NBFCs.
rows.verification_status: CCI official FAQ confirms scope and duration; original exemption Gazette not independently retrieved.

rows.rule: Any applicable section 5 threshold can trigger combinations review, including the deal-value test.
rows.entities: Enterprises/groups including banks and NBFCs unless exempt
rows.provision: Competition Act sections 5(a)–(d), 6; CCI Combinations Regulations 2024 regulation 4(1)–(2)
rows.effective_date: Raised financial thresholds March 2024; 2024 combinations regime effective 2024-09-10; current 2026 CCI guidance retrieved
rows.required_action: Test Indian enterprise assets > INR 2,500 crore or turnover > INR 7,500 crore; group > INR 10,000/30,000 crore. Also test worldwide/India limbs and transaction value > INR 2,000 crore with substantial Indian operations. Do not close a notifiable deal before the applicable approval/standstill process.
rows.verification_status: Official 2026 guidance supports thresholds. No deal-level legal calculation is performed.

rows.rule: A web FAQ is insufficient evidence that a time-limited exemption has been renewed.
rows.entities: Small targets; section 45 banking companies; other exempt classes
rows.provision: S.O. 1131(E), 2024-03-07; Competition Act sections 5 and 54; S.O. 1034(E), 2022-03-11 for qualifying section 45 banks
rows.effective_date: 2024 small-target notification: two-year duration; section 45 notification: five-year duration from publication
rows.required_action: Do not auto-apply the INR 450 crore assets/1,250 crore turnover exemption on 2026-10-16: the cited two-year notification expired and renewal was not verified. Require current Gazette/legal review; independently assess deal-value notification and any special exemption.
rows.verification_status: Unresolved current exemption: CCI pages still state thresholds while describing a two-year sunset. No renewal inferred.

rows.rule: Bank financial presentation follows Banking Regulation Act formats and RBI directions; Ind AS implementation remains deferred in the retrieved current statement direction.
rows.entities: Commercial banks as defined by paragraph 3, including corresponding new banks
rows.provision: Banking Regulation Act section 29 / Third Schedule; RBI Commercial Banks Financial Statements Directions 2025 paragraphs 3–5 and Chapter III, Ind AS implementation disclosure
rows.effective_date: 2025-11-28; retrieved consolidated direction updated 2026-07-01
rows.required_action: Tag accounting basis and consolidation scope by period. Use actual scheme/accounting notes for merger recognition; never assume Ind AS 103 purchase accounting for BoB 2019.
rows.verification_status: Current official text verified; use contemporaneous filings for historical reporting.

rows.rule: NPA/provision and capital definitions are versioned RBI concepts; neither capital ratios nor NPA ratios may be averaged.
rows.entities: Relevant commercial banks
rows.transaction_type: Post-merger prudential reporting and historical reconstruction
rows.provision: RBI Commercial Banks IRACP Directions 2025; Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy Directions 2025; individual disclosure tables
rows.effective_date: Current index: IRACP updated 2026-10-01; capital updated 2026-10-07
rows.required_action: Use disclosed regulatory numerators, net/gross denominators, risk-weighted assets and capital deductions. Keep period-specific historic rules. Block calculated capital conclusions without compatible underlying amounts.
rows.verification_status: Current titles/update dates verified; full updated operative text was not exposed by the retrieved pages. No compliance certificate or capital-threshold determination.

rows.rule: The 2026 bank ECL direction is issued but its commencement is future relative to this review.
rows.entities: Banks within the 2026 direction's applicability
rows.provision: RBI Commercial Banks Asset Classification, Provisioning and Income Recognition Directions 2026, paragraphs 2–3, 19, 106–112 and 147–148
rows.effective_date: Issued 2026-04-27; effective 2027-04-01; transitional CET1 add-back through 2030–31
rows.required_action: Do not apply future ECL retroactively to 2019. For future cases show fully loaded and transitional capital separately; capture opening-equity adjustments and first reporting dates.
rows.verification_status: Official commencement, transition and disclosure paragraphs verified. This is enacted future direction, not currently applicable to FY2019–20.

rows.rule: Ind AS eligibility is determined by Companies Rules and category; Ind AS ECL and regulatory NPA/provision measures need reconciliation.
rows.entities: NBFC categories/layers specified by paragraphs 3–8
rows.provision: RBI NBFC Financial Statements Directions 2025 paragraphs 10–12 and 21(15); Companies (Ind AS) Rules 2015 rule 4
rows.effective_date: 2025-11-28; consolidated version updated 2026-07-01
rows.required_action: Store Ind AS applicability, stage-3 and regulatory NPA separately; use the disclosed ECL/IRACP bridge and impairment reserve. Determine Ind AS 103/common-control or AS 14 treatment from applicable standards and actual scheme; never infer it solely from transaction name.
rows.verification_status: RBI rule-4 reference and prudential-floor reconciliation verified; individual Ind AS scope and merger-accounting conclusions need specialist review.

rows.rule: NBFC capital requirements differ by category/layer and cannot inherit bank Basel metrics blindly.
rows.entities: Eligible NBFCs; Middle/Upper/Top layers and category exceptions
rows.provision: RBI NBFC Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy Directions 2025 paragraphs 3 and 6–10; NBFC IRACP Directions 2025
rows.effective_date: 2025-11-28; capital updated 2026-07-01; IRACP indexed update 2026-10-01
rows.required_action: Select entity/layer first. Paragraph 6 contains 15% CRAR for ML and above, 10% Tier 1 and UL 9% CET1, subject to scope/exceptions. Store RWA, deductions and applicable requirements; mark bank deposit mix inapplicable to non-deposit businesses.
rows.verification_status: Capital paragraph 6 verified; current IRACP landing page only. Not a completeness assessment of subtype-specific prudential rules.

rows.rule: Time-limited concessions and one-offs must be tied to their own legal authority and issuer use.
rows.entities: Banks/NBFCs with documented relief
rows.provision: Applicable RBI order/circular and issuer note; example: bank Financial Statements Directions Chapter III family-pension amortisation disclosure
rows.effective_date: Example applies from FY2021–22 for up to five years; no BoB 2019 merger-specific relief inferred
rows.required_action: Record amount, eligibility, start/end date, P&L/equity impact and fully loaded alternative. An undisclosed relief adjustment stays unknown, not zero; do not count unrelated sector relief as merger synergy.
rows.verification_status: Example official provision verified; comprehensive BoB relief inventory and any case-specific RBI letters remain outside verified evidence.

rows.rule: Carry-forward and merger tax treatment depend on statutory eligibility and period; a merger does not automatically create a recognised tax asset.
rows.entities: BoB/Vijaya/Dena and other qualifying historical amalgamations
rows.provision: Income-tax Act 1961 sections 2(1B), 47(vi)/(vii), 72A and 72AA; section 72AA(ii) concerns corresponding new banks
rows.effective_date: Historical transaction/year law required; retrieved section 72AA is a later consolidated version, not the 2019 text
rows.required_action: Use actual tax/DTA notes and verify retrospective amendments before attributing a tax benefit. Keep cash tax, recognised DTA and future tax-loss capacity separate; no benefit is computed from eligibility alone.
rows.verification_status: Current historical-Act provision verified; 2019 effective amendments and exact realised tax benefit not reconstructed.

rows.rule: The Income-tax Act 2025 commenced in 2026; earlier-year proceedings retain transitional treatment under the former Act.
rows.entities: Indian taxpayers, including future merger cases
rows.provision: Income-tax Act 2025 sections 1(3), 2(6), 116 and 117 (including 117(1)(b) for corresponding new banks); repeal/savings framework; official transition guidance
rows.effective_date: 2026-04-01; tax years beginning earlier remain under historical law per official FAQ
rows.required_action: Version tax-law mappings by tax year. Section 117(2) limits eligible loss carry-forward for schemes effective from 2025-04-01 to eight tax years after the original predecessor loss year. Verify eligibility, loss vintage and subsequent amendments before computing any benefit; do not reuse 1961 section numbers as current-law answers.
rows.verification_status: New Act commencement, sections 2(6)/117 and official transition guidance verified; full section 116 conditions and 2026 amendments not exhaustively checked.

rows.rule: Public access does not grant automatic commercial redistribution rights.
rows.entities: Product operator; exchange/issuer/publisher data sources
rows.transaction_type: Retrieval, storage, display, export and resale
rows.provision: NSE Data Sharing & Usage Policy, sections 7 and 10–12; Copyright Act 1957 sections 14, 51 and 52
rows.effective_date: Source contract/policy version at retrieval; no universal licence date
rows.required_action: Keep a per-source rights record: automation permitted, retention, excerpt/export rights and attribution. Default unverified feeds to manual review; link issuer originals and avoid redistributing full filings. No paywall/control/rate-limit bypass. BSE/publisher licences require separate verification.
rows.verification_status: NSE official terms and Copyright Act retrieved. No licence grant established; attribution alone is insufficient. BSE terms not verified.

rows.rule: DPDP has staggered commencement; core fiduciary obligations are not all in force on the review date.
rows.entities: Operators processing covered digital personal data; exemptions require separate analysis
rows.transaction_type: User accounts, uploads, analytics and logs
rows.provision: DPDP Act 2023 section 1(2); G.S.R. 843(E); DPDP Rules 2025 rule 1; G.S.R. 846(E) and corrigendum 892(E)
rows.effective_date: Published 2025-11-13; institutional provisions immediate; consent-manager phase after one year; main duties after eighteen months (scheduled November 2026/May 2027)
rows.required_action: Maintain phased obligations rather than a single 'DPDP compliant' flag. Confirm publication-date computation and later notifications before launch. Do not confuse January 2025 draft rules with final rules.
rows.verification_status: Final Gazette and December corrigendum verified. As of 2026-10-16 later phases are scheduled, not deemed commenced.

rows.rule: Plan for notices, security, retention/deletion and breach communications under the final rules.
rows.entities: Covered data fiduciaries/processors when substantive provisions commence
rows.provision: DPDP Act sections 3–8, 11–14; Rules 3, 6–9; rule 7 notification and rule 8(3) retention
rows.effective_date: Scheduled eighteen months after 2025-11-13 publication; not treated as operative on 2026-10-16
rows.required_action: Minimise personal data, document purpose and deletion, control access and processor contracts. Future breach plan must distinguish notice without delay from detailed Board follow-up within 72 hours; reconcile rule 8(3)'s minimum retention with deletion and other legal holds.
rows.verification_status: Final rule text verified; applicability and exemptions require counsel. Proposed product controls are design requirements, not claims of implemented compliance.

rows.rule: Existing IT Act/SPDI duties may apply before DPDP's substantive phase; uploads can contain sensitive financial or identity data.
rows.entities: Covered body corporates/persons in India handling sensitive personal data
rows.transaction_type: Collection, storage, transfer and disclosure of sensitive personal data
rows.provision: IT Act section 43A; SPDI Rules 2011 rules 3–8; 2011 official clarification; DPDP Act section 44(2) commencement
rows.effective_date: SPDI 2011 publication; section 43A omission scheduled with DPDP eighteen-month phase
rows.required_action: Publish a privacy policy; collect only needed data with applicable consent, security and transfer safeguards. Separate user document deletion from legally required security-log retention. Evaluate direct-customer versus processor roles.
rows.verification_status: Official rule text/clarification and DPDP commencement retrieved; precise role/application and any later amendments require legal review.

rows.rule: Covered entities must report specified incidents within six hours and retain ICT logs securely in India for 180 days.
rows.entities: Service providers, intermediaries, data centres, body corporates and government organisations within scope
rows.transaction_type: Operating the application or hosting uploaded documents
rows.provision: IT Act section 70B(6); CERT-In Directions 20(3)/2022 of 2022-04-28, clauses (i)–(iv) and Annexure I; official FAQ
rows.effective_date: Direction states sixty days from issue; general compliance operational date June 2022; specific extensions require role check
rows.required_action: Name an incident contact; synchronise clocks; preserve access/security logs for rolling 180 days within India where applicable; triage and report covered incidents within six hours of noticing/notification. Do not wait for a completed forensic investigation. Restrict access and omit document bodies/secrets from logs.
rows.verification_status: Directions and FAQ verified. Five-year subscriber-record duty is for specified provider classes, not automatically every dashboard.

rows.rule: Company-specific analysis for consideration may be research services; a disclaimer or lack of a price target does not decide the classification.
rows.entities: Publisher/seller of securities-related reports; tool operator depending on service and monetisation
rows.transaction_type: Publishing, subscriptions, paid reports, indirect consideration
rows.provision: SEBI RA Regulations 2014 regulations 2(1)(fa), 2(1)(u), 2(1)(w)/(wa), 3; Master Circular 2026 paragraph 1.8 and FAQ 4/8
rows.effective_date: RA consolidated regulations last amended 2025-11-25; master circular 2026-02-06
rows.required_action: Before public launch or monetisation, obtain RA classification/registration advice for actual report wording, distribution, incentives and business model. Factual statistical-summary exclusion cannot simply be asserted for interpretive issuer verdicts. No buy/sell/hold or price targets.
rows.verification_status: Current SEBI index and official master circular verified. Product is not legally cleared; later consultation proposals are not treated as enacted exemptions.

rows.rule: Personalised securities advice for consideration can trigger a separate investment-adviser regime.
rows.entities: Operator offering individual recommendations, portfolios or suitability advice
rows.provision: SEBI IA Regulations 2013 regulations 2(1)(l), 2(1)(m), 3 and applicable exemptions
rows.effective_date: Consolidated regulations last amended 2025-11-25; current index verified 2026-10-16
rows.required_action: Keep report analysis non-personalised. Do not add portfolio suitability or trade recommendations without IA legal review/registration assessment; disclose factual/estimate/interpretation boundaries.
rows.verification_status: Official consolidated landing page verified; no determination that the product falls outside IA/RA regulation.

limitations: Official sources were retrieved on 2026-10-16. Website update labels are evidence of the retrieved version, not proof that every intervening Gazette, court decision or transaction-specific approval was checked.
BoB 2019 legal identity/effective date is verified from its Gazette. Full transaction approval, tax and regulatory-relief files have not been independently audited.

CCI's retrieved official pages retain small-target thresholds but identify a two-year March 2024 notification; an operative renewal after March 2026 was not verified. Treat current exemption as unresolved.

RBI 2025 entity-specific directions replace relying on the prompt's older starting points. Some current prudential landing pages expose titles but not full amended text; those rows explicitly remain partial.
SEBI consolidated index shows LODR July 14 2026 and RA/IA November 25 2025 versions; later individual circulars and stock-exchange SOPs were not exhaustively reconciled.

Data licences, BSE terms, publisher permissions, source redistribution rights, public-launch privacy implementation and RA/IA classification require qualified review. This demo does not confer any licence or registration.
Legal-review flags are about unresolved application. A false flag on the narrow historical scheme classification is not a statement that the merger or product is legally cleared.
